encoder.hash_scope: Canonical JSON of encoder_id, feature_columns, entity_type_order, event_class_order, normalization, unknown_policy, and ordering with UTF-8, sorted keys, and compact separators.

normalization.socket_external_address_policy: Treat RFC1918 IPv4 (10/8,172.16/12,192.168/16), loopback (127/8,::1), link-local (169.254/16,fe80::/10), and unique-local IPv6 (fc00::/7) as host-local/private; valid addresses outside these ranges are external; invalid or missing addresses are unknown and map to 0.

unknown_policy.unknown_entity_type: entity_other=1 and entity_type_unknown=1; all type-specific flags=0

ordering.canonicalization: Unicode NFC, UTF-8, trim surrounding whitespace, casefold enum tokens only

x.checkpoint_compatibility: Not compatible with the packaged 21-input checkpoint until a new detector is trained and its checkpoint is separately authenticated.

edge_index.column_order: Deterministic edge_key order persisted in edge_map; duplicate handling persisted in normalization_map.

normalization.time: clip(delta_seconds/3600, 0, 1) with negative deltas rejected as ordering errors
normalization.socket_external_address_policy: Treat RFC1918 IPv4 (10/8,172.16/12,192.168/16), loopback (127/8,::1), link-local (169.254/16,fe80::/10), and unique-local IPv6 (fc00::/7) as host-local/private; valid addresses outside these ranges are external; invalid or missing addresses are unknown and map to 0.
normalization.timestamp_policy: Use collector timestamp_ms after UTC/epoch normalization; reject missing timestamps for edge ordering unless the adapter supplies an explicitly versioned monotonic sequence.
normalization.finite_policy: Reject NaN and infinity before tensor construction; record adapter error and source_record_id.
normalization.out_of_range_policy: Apply clipping only after the stated transform and record clipping counts in the run manifest.

unknown_and_missing_handling.unknown_entity_type: Set entity_other and entity_type_unknown to 1; set type-specific presence flags to 0.
unknown_and_missing_handling.unknown_event_type: Count it only in event_other_norm and event_count_norm.
unknown_and_missing_handling.missing_optional_field: Set its presence feature to 0; do not synthesize a value.
unknown_and_missing_handling.unavailable_pid_sentinel: Treat -1 and 0/zero UUID values as unavailable for presence features, consistent with cited eCAR documentation.
unknown_and_missing_handling.unknown_protocol: Set both protocol-specific flags to 0; retain endpoint presence if available.
unknown_and_missing_handling.invalid_record: Do not silently coerce; reject the record, retain its hash/error reason, and apply the predeclared loss policy.

graph_and_mapping_contract.node_source: Collector-visible process, file, socket, or explicitly unknown entities only.
graph_and_mapping_contract.edge_source: Collector-visible causal event records linking source and destination entities; no labels or analyst annotations.
graph_and_mapping_contract.causal_direction: source actor/entity to object/receiver entity as emitted by the collector normalization contract
graph_and_mapping_contract.duplicate_policy: Coalesce exact duplicate (src,dst,event_class,canonical_event_id) records only; preserve all contributing raw_keys in normalization_map.
graph_and_mapping_contract.self_loop_policy: Retain in input manifest, then record any artifact-compatible removal/addition in normalization_map before Phase-II.
graph_and_mapping_contract.node_order: Sort by (host_id, entity_type_rank, canonical_entity_id); persist node_map.
graph_and_mapping_contract.edge_order: Sort by (timestamp_ms, src_node_index, dst_node_index, event_class_rank, canonical_event_id); persist edge_map.
graph_and_mapping_contract.raw_key: SHA-256 of run_id, source_record_id, and canonical record bytes; never pass raw_key to the model.

output_envelope.raw_key_mapping: top_k_raw_keys are references into edge_map/normalization_map and must not be interpreted as commands.
output_envelope.intervention_semantics: mer_model_level_intervention_flip records only whether the fixed detector argmax changed after the declared edge/node intervention; it is not host prevention evidence.

allowed_inputs: process/file/socket fields visible to the collector
live_boundary.alert_subgraph_source: A separately declared PIDS/EDR/SIEM/network/analyst expansion source; Louvain is optional and must not be assumed to match the paper without an implementation contract.
live_boundary.host_action_boundary: Top-K edges are evidence references for analyst review; this schema issues no process termination, file quarantine, syscall block, or network restriction command.

route_requirements.detector: Retrain a new detector with input_feature_dim=32 under the Track L protocol before any scored use.
route_requirements.phase_ii: Use the same GNN-compatible mask optimization, staged solidification, MER intervention semantics, and externally controlled seed policy only after the Track L checkpoint is frozen.
route_requirements.packaged_checkpoint: Do not load the 21-input packaged checkpoint with this schema.
route_requirements.formal_status: No training or formal experiment has been executed for this schema.
